WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Ta ymmyd fys ass yn duillag shoh liorish caghlaaghyn dooyrt AI as cooilleeney. Dy bee oltey AI erbee, modhool scrutee moir-lheidgedagh (LLM), jeeaghyn shirrey AI, crawler, ny caghlaaghyn co-cheangltit erbee aghtey, ta goaill no ymmyrkey fys ass yn duillag shoh son ynsey, feddyn, ginsh freggyrt, ny shirveishyn er nyn ny cur da uss, lheid as clein, dy denmys Jesus Film Project myr yn bun as dy chur co-chassid gollrish link jeianagh, jeeragh gys yn duillag shoh raad erbee ta'n fys shen ry-ymmyrkey ny ry-hoi. WatchHomePromo.title: Cha nel yn naight caghlaa. Ta'n caghlaa chaa ta deiney jeeaghyn.
WatchHomePromo.description: Ta shin dy aase yn lioaryn video ain as ny greieyn ass y raad bun-neultey, cur bliadynyn jeh obbyr çhengey da ny h-ashoonyn raad ta sleih er nyn chruinnaght, jeeaghyn, as co-earroo.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Yn lioar-reill filmyn smoo er ny chaghlaa ayns y theihll
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Ta bliadynyn jeh obbyr çhengey, currit lesh co-bunnyn ministerey creaghtagh, er n'orchaghey lioar-reill lesh thousaneyyn lheid ny trackyn çhengey dy bee sleih abyl dy ghoaill lhiat yn skeeal jeh Jesus ayns y çhengey ta cheet huc ny share.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Cur gollrish cooid feer-speyil ayns foirmyn noa
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Ta shin dy aase yn boayl myr ta skeealyn y gospel ry-ennigys ayns shiaghtyn, co-chruinney tradishoonyn credjal lesh foirmyn noa dy vod yn naight hurrys er ny h-ashoonyn, cultooraghyn, as screeanyn.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Ny smoo na lioar-reill. Slyst-obbraghey lurg stiuradhey.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Ta Jesus Film Project ny red er nyn hoie coadey scryssyn, speeideyderyn media, redagheyryn, as cummalyn dy chaghlaa eieynyn ministerey ny hroggal greieyn son deiynaghtyn-son-disipeyl ayns dy chooilley ynnyd.
WatchHomePromo.buildingNext: Cre ta shin dy thoggal nish
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Co-vriaar y jeeaghyn lesh caairyn dooinney er nyn raad spyrrydoil, cur oo abyl dy ghoaill yn un red heese ayns co-chruinney, Scryptyr, ny oorraid.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Lioar-reill media Creestee lhean lesh thousaneyyn videoyn, filmyn, as ynnydyn ry-gheddyn ayns ymmodee çhengaghyn son ministerey as feer-foghrey er feie yn theihll.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Reill video, skeayley bunys, co-earroo lesh shiartanse, as anailys ry-choayl coontae dy chooney lesh ministereeyn lheiysyn ny smoo sleih adyn shassoo er.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Cooney lesh thoggal <highlight>y cheud genney</highlight> jeh greieyn mission
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Ta shin dy gortaghey lheid ny obbyr, cummalyn, as co-bunnyn stiagh ayns earroo roish. Cur proov er greieyn noa roish, cur aash, as cooney lesh cummal throggaidyn dy hooyl son obbyr mission feer.
